name: Pax Historia
long_description:
Pax Historia is an AI powered sandbox game where players create and upload whatever worlds they can imagine for others to play. What if Rome never fell? What if aliens invaded Earth? What if you were a college dropout creating a tech startup? 

The ability to create, edit, and copy custom maps, actors, historical context, and more means that users can play nearly any scenario they can imagine.

We've organically built a passionate fanbase of tens of thousands of daily active players and we're excited to expand on this early start. Consider joining us to help build vastly better tools for creators and experiences for players.
one_liner: The first AI-powered worldbuilding and gameplay platform

launches.title: Pax Historia - User & AI powered gaming platform
launches.tagline: 🗺️ The first alternate-history sandbox game powered by AI
launches.body:
Hey! This is **Eli** and **Ryan**, cofounders at **Pax Historia** ([paxhistoria.co](http://paxhistoria.co)). 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97520&key=user_uploads/1382898/f7de4ff4-c0d2-4a10-9785-d2ca30e30949)

Pax Historia is a map-based gaming platform which combines the creative freedom of sandbox games with the depth of grand strategy. Players imagine scenarios (like ‘What if the USSR hadn’t broken apart?’ or ‘What if a zombie outbreak started in 2019?’ or ‘What if the USA took over Greenland?’) and create maps and presets which are then published to the community and become playable by anyone.

Already, we have **35k daily users**. Over the last week, in total, we’ve processed **100+ billion tokens**. Our **passionate community has published over 4k presets** with 50+ plays each.  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97520&key=user_uploads/1382898/099acb66-577a-4be7-973c-109c16087c69)

Creators create, edit, and publish custom maps and worlds. Users then play as a country or group in the world. They can make actions, start diplomatic chats, and jump forward in time. As the game progresses, the map shows any changes from player actions. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97520&key=user_uploads/1382898/062a68cf-5178-40bf-888d-e31b681431c2)

By using AI to power the responses of other countries/actors to in-game actions, **we are able to move beyond constraining, pre-designed narrative paths**. Players are truly able to do whatever they can imagine. 

Check out our [Pax Historia Launch Video](https://youtu.be/-RXSxMVLcL4) for a closer look.

**Our asks**: 

1. **Feedback:** We would _love_ to hear your feedback (especially if you’re a grand strategy, history, or gaming nerd!). You can make an account [here](http://paxhistoria.co).
2. **Talent:** We are hiring! If you know of any talented engineers (Unity, web dev, AI/ML) who might be interested in a super high-impact, fast moving, small team, then please connect us. They can apply through our [Ashby](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/pax-historia), but please also shoot us an email ([careers@paxhistoria.co](mailto:careers@paxhistoria.co)) so we can find their profile.
3. **Connection & Community:** Finally, if you’re running platforms/marketplaces, who are using AI to power features within their service (not just to write code!), or just excited by building and maintaining online communities, then we would love to chat.
